notes: You can switch plugins on and off again. Plugins running in the hub never reach DungeonHelper's own enable/disable list, so 0.2.x left you with no way to turn one off — every plugin page now has an Enabled switch at the top, and it takes effect immediately: switching off shuts the plugin down properly, so its timers and automation actually stop, and switching back on starts it again without restarting DungeonHelper. Switched-off plugins stay in the sidebar, greyed out and marked 'off', so you can always find one to turn back on, and the setting is remembered between sessions — a plugin left off is never started at all.
